name: pi-ark
description: Workspace-oriented web interface for the pi coding agent

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pi-ark/server" "npm run dev -w @pi-ark/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-ark/web && npm run build -w @pi-ark/server
scripts.check: npm run check -w @pi-ark/web && npm run check -w @pi-ark/server
scripts.check:behavior: tsx scripts/check-conversation.ts && tsx scripts/check-compaction-stats.ts && tsx scripts/check-session-cache.ts && tsx scripts/check-session-status.ts && tsx scripts/check-session-selection.ts && tsx scripts/check-attachments.ts && tsx scripts/check-auth-flow.ts && tsx scripts/check-model-preferences.ts && tsx scripts/check-session-actions.ts && tsx scripts/check-questions.ts && tsx scripts/check-question-loop.ts && tsx scripts/check-pi-ark-links.ts && tsx scripts/check-system-prompt.ts && tsx scripts/check-skills.ts && tsx scripts/check-mcp.ts && tsx scripts/check-webfetch.ts && tsx scripts/check-file-search.ts && tsx scripts/check-composer-suggest.ts && tsx scripts/check-files.ts && npm run check:file-links && tsx scripts/check-instances.ts && node scripts/check-setup.mjs && node scripts/platform-check.mjs && tsx scripts/check-notebook.ts && tsx scripts/check-subagents.ts && tsx scripts/check-terminal.ts && tsx scripts/check-terminal-appearance.ts && tsx scripts/check-typography.ts && tsx scripts/check-workspace-order.ts && tsx scripts/check-working-count.ts && npm run check:release-process
